claim: An accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator can point to at most 42 AWS Regions across all listeners and endpoint groups. The total number of listeners multiplied by the number of endpoint groups must not exceed 42.
question: How many AWS Regions can one Global Accelerator accelerator point to, and how do listeners affect that number?

qualifiers.scope: per accelerator, across all listeners and endpoint groups
qualifiers.condition: (total number of listeners) x (number of endpoint groups) must not exceed 42
